g.text: TB1: browser to web (port 8080 on all host interfaces). TB2: web to DB. TB3: input to OS execution. TB4: Ping to an external target.
TB5: operator to workload configuration. TB6: root web container to the Docker host (socket and project-tree mounts). TB7: network to the published DB port.
A boundary marks a trust change, not an effective defense. Logs and DB files remain inside their service trust.
